map.按场景与角色生成应急预案清单与演练步骤，可导出用于培训，用于突发事件准备参考，纯: Generate emergency plan checklists and drill steps by scenario and role, exportable for training, for emergency preparedness reference; generated in the pure front end.
map.单位安全演练规划：安全主管输入需要的数量（如 5 份），工具从 8 类场所预案模: Unit safety drill planning: the safety officer enters the number needed (for example 5) and the tool randomly generates matching drill checklists from 8 site plan templates (office building / home / mall / metro / hospital / school / high-rise residential / outdoor), covering different scenarios.
map.社区/家庭预案制定：为住宅、高层住户快速生成避险预案（伏地遮挡手抓牢、关闭燃气电: Community/household planning: quickly generate shelter plans for homes and high-rise residents (drop, cover and hold on, shut off gas and power, evacuate by stairs and so on), and state the recommended drill cycle.
map.应急培训材料生成：培训机构按数量批量导出多份预案作为案例，每份含关键步骤与建议演: Emergency training material generation: training organizations export several plans in batch as case studies, each containing key steps and a suggested drill frequency, ready for training or drill scheduling.
map.：输入数量 cnt=5，工具从 plans 模板池（共 8 类）随机抽取 5 份: : Enter count cnt=5, the tool randomly draws 5 from the plans template pool (8 types in total) and outputs in turn, for example '1. Earthquake emergency evacuation plan (office buildings, schools and other crowded places) | key steps: shelter nearby -> protect the head -> evacuate in order -> count heads -> assemble and report | drill cycle: once every six months' ... up to the 5th. Each plan contains three items - scenario, key steps and suggested drill cycle - and can be used directly for drill scheduling or training material.
map.预案覆盖哪些场所类型？: What site types do the plans cover?
map.内置 8 类模板：地震应急疏散（人员密集场所）、家庭避险、商场客流管控、地铁停运: Eight built-in template types: earthquake evacuation (crowded places), household sheltering, shopping mall crowd control, metro suspension, hospital patient transfer, school desk sheltering, high-rise residential escape and outdoor sheltering, basically covering common scenarios.
map.为什么用随机抽取而不是固定顺序？: Why use random selection rather than a fixed order?
map.随机抽取可避免每次演练都重复相同预案，便于单位轮训不同场景；如需固定某类，可多次: Random selection avoids repeating the same plan in every drill, making it easier for a unit to rotate through different scenarios; if you need to fix a category, generate several times or filter manually after export.
